slides.title: Tattoo shop owners, quick quiz. Be honest.
Bloodborne pathogens training was 14 months ago. Still good?
slides.body: No. OSHA expects workers exposed to blood to get this training every year.

slides.title: A guest artist starts Friday. Does your shop license cover them?
slides.body: Check their own license. Many states and counties license artists individually.

slides.title: The license renewal notice went to an old email. Who finds out first?
slides.body: The health inspector. Keep the date yourself.

slides.title: How many did you get right?
